definitions: The action of following and observing someone closely, especially as a detective or spy.
The practice of following a professional for a period to learn about their work.
The casting of a shadow by an object or person.
A technique in radio communication where a signal is blocked or attenuated by an obstruction.
examples: The detective's shadowing of the suspect led to an arrest.
She gained valuable experience through shadowing a surgeon.
The shadowing of the trees created a cool spot.
Signal loss due to shadowing was a common issue.
